segments.<strong>Riešenie</strong>\n Cha: Solution A chatbot with lead qualification — before the call it asks the prospect about the type of product, timeframe and current contracts. The adviser receives a structured summary.

segments.<strong>Riešenie</strong>\n Cha: Solution A chatbot with FAQ — it answers common questions, collects the prospect’s contact details and sends a notification. Appointments are booked via a calendar link.
segments.Menej prerušení počas práce. Zákazníci d: Fewer interruptions during work. Customers get an answer immediately — even when the owner is out on a job.
